subject.title: fix(agents): agent-created files get lowercased names on Windows

question: Does the case-preserving normalization retain every accepted and rejected Windows workspace-boundary decision while fixing only the returned filename casing?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and well tested, but it changes the values passed into a security-sensitive containment calculation, so final acceptance requires owner judgment rather than automated repair.

options.title: Approve after boundary review
options.body: Confirm the drive, UNC, extended-prefix, root, and escape equivalence argument and merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Request broader Windows matrix
options.body: Require additional real-Windows containment cases if the existing source proof and focused tests do not sufficiently establish equivalence.

options.title: Separate check and return paths
options.body: Rework the branch to validate with comparison-normalized paths and separately compute the returned path from case-preserving originals.

recommendation.title: Approve after boundary review
recommendation.body: Confirm the drive, UNC, extended-prefix, root, and escape equivalence argument and merge after exact-head checks pass.
